title: TaskRequest
description: What an application sends the STS to start a task: an OAuth 2.0 token exchange (RFC 8693), shown as JSON. On the wire it is form-encoded, with authorization_details as a JSON string (RFC 9396). The user's identity, sign-in strength and session come from subject_token; the response is a one-time ticket for the named agent.

subject_token.description: The user's identity: an ID token from one of the application's idps, or a JWT the application signed itself when its users are self_asserted.

authorization_details.description: Exactly one agent_task entry: which task, about which object, for which agent.

client_assertion.description: The application's signed JWT, for private_key_jwt (RFC 7523 §2.2). Applications that authenticate another way send neither field.

agentTask.description: The task to start. The scope comes from the task type, never from the request.

object_id.description: ID of the object the task is about; it must match the task type's id_pattern.

agent.description: The agent the ticket is for.
